text_block_list.text:
One day, after running through countless 
races—

While sorting through Eishin Flash's past 
race records, something suddenly caught my 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You've won two GⅠ races held at Tokyo 
Racecourse... is that right?

Not only had she won two GⅠs—which are 
notoriously difficult to win in the first 
place— but she had also won both at the 
exact same racecourse.
choice_data_list: Maybe Flash is just good at Tokyo.
Maybe Flash is just good at Tokyo, huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. I know you're referring to the 
course, but I found that to be a rather 
amusing expression.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Tokyo... might not be my strongest suit.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
On the first day of my study abroad, I 
made my way from the airport to the 
station near the academy all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The academy offered to send someone to 
pick me up, but I was confident in 
following the directions, so I came on my 
own.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We made it out of the airport and safely 
arrived at the terminal station.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However... I got lost there. The route 
guidance doesn't work very well inside 
buildings.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, it was adjacent to many 
commercial facilities, so the space 
expanded in all directions—up, down, left, 
and right—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In my confusion, I ended up speaking to 
the station staff in German.
choice_data_list: So even Flash has moments like that, huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That was only that one time. Ever since, I 
made sure to take proper photos of the 
campus map to compare and study them.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"To think that *I* am 'suited for 
Tokyo'... What an intriguing twist of 
fate."
choice_data_list: From today on, I can say it with pride!
From today on, I can say it with pride!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes, I shall do so.
